'''Season:''' Carlos Castillo (16) | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | total goals = | average goals = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest losses = | prevseason = [[2007–08 Liga Nacional de Guatemala|2007–08]] | nextseason = [[2009–10 Liga Nacional de Guatemala|2009–10]] }} The '''2008–09 Liga Nacional de Guatemala''' was the 56th professional season of the top-flight football league in [[Guatemala]]. The season was divided into two championships—the [[#Apertura|2008 Apertura]] and the [[#Clausura|2009 Clausura]]—each in an identical format and each contested by the same 12 teams. The first six clubs in the standings at the end of each competition participate in the playoffs (a two-leg knock-out phase) to determine the champion; the first and second place teams qualify directly to the semi-finals, while the other two have to play in the quarter-finals.
